title: ClaimPlus
body:
# 🏡 ClaimPlus **Protect your builds. Your land, your rules.** ClaimPlus is a lightweight but powerful area claiming plugin for PaperMC 1.21.x that lets players protect exactly the space they want not entire chunks, not full height columns, but the precise 3D region they select. Built with WorldGuard compatibility in mind, it slots cleanly into any existing server setup without conflict. [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue)]() [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21.x-orange)]() [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/downloads-1+-green)]() ---


--- ## ✨ Features ### 🔲 Precision Area Claiming Select any rectangular area using the claim wand just like WorldEdit. Claims protect the exact Y range you select, so a basement claim won't interfere with what's built above it. ### 🛡️ Granular Protection Flags Toggle protections on or off per claim: - Block breaking & placing - Lava & water flow - Fire spread - Creeper & TNT explosions - Mob spawning - Chest & container access - Button, lever & door interactions - Item drop & pickup - PvP *(admin-controllable — prevent players from creating safe zones)* ### 👥 Member System Add trusted players to your claim and control exactly what they can do build, open chests, use levers, manage other members, or change flags. Full per-permission granularity. ### ⚙️ Admin Control Panel Admins decide which features players are allowed to use at all. Want to prevent players from disabling PvP in their claims so nobody can abuse safe zones? One line in the config. Every flag can be locked by server admins independently. ### 📊 Claim Block Limits - Set a default block limit for all players - Assign a higher VIP limit by username list or permission node - Set per-player custom limits with a single command great for donor ranks ### 🌍 WorldGuard Compatible ClaimPlus is fully aware of WorldGuard. It never overrides WorldGuard decisions, respects your existing regions, and can optionally prevent players from claiming inside WorldGuard-protected areas entirely. --- ## 🎮 Commands | Command | Description | |---|---| | `/claimplus wand` | Get the claim selection wand | | `/claimplus claim [name]` | Create a claim from your selection | | `/claimplus unclaim ` | Delete one of your claims | | `/claimplus flag ` | Set a protection flag | | `/claimplus member add/remove/grant/revoke ...` | Manage members & permissions | | `/claimplus list` | View all your claims | | `/claimplus blocks` | Check remaining claim blocks | | `/claimadmin list [player]` | View all claims on the server | | `/claimadmin delete ` | Delete any claim | | `/claimadmin setlimit ` | Set a custom block limit | | `/claimadmin bypass` | Toggle admin bypass mode | | `/claimadmin teleport ` | Teleport to any claim | | `/claimadmin reload` | Reload config without restart | --- ## 🔧 Requirements - **Server:** PaperMC 1.21.x - **Java:** 21+ - **WorldGuard:** Optional, auto-detected if present --- ## 📦 Installation 1. Drop `ClaimPlus.jar` into your `/plugins` folder 2. Start the server config generates automatically 3. Edit `plugins/ClaimPlus/config.yml` to configure limits, flags and VIP players 4. Run `/claimadmin reload` to apply changes --- *Made by Rradajbi*
